title: Pig King leaves the pen: the party brawler is out in Steam Early Access, AED 17 at launch

sources.note: Steam store page and appdetails (cc=ae): Early Access, 12 Nov 2026, Windows only, AED 17.00 after 17% launch discount (20.49 before), developer TwoPeaks, publisher Isle of Strays; up to 4 players, PvP and co-op; Steam Deck tested by the developer
TwoPeaks Steam announcement 'PIG KING IS OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS!': limited 17% early access discount, launch stream 7 PM CET, Dev Bash 27 Nov

first_report: TwoPeaks Steam announcement 12 Nov 2026 about 16:00Z (5 PM CET launch); Famitsu covered it 13 Nov 07:52Z; about 30 h old at the slot, no Arabic coverage found, so it runs as a story the Arabic press has not carried
